name: Chair Incline Push-Up
description: An incline push-up on a chair braced against a wall: hands on the front edge of the seat, lower your chest toward it and press back up.

source.title: Incline Push-Up (NASM Exercise Library)
source.note: From your full-body routine, described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Push the chair back against a wall so it can't slide.
Hands on the front edge of the seat, shoulder-width apart, and step your feet back into a plank.
cues: Body in one straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the seat.
Press through your palms back to straight arms.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Arms straight
keyframes.cue: Hands on the seat edge, body straight.

keyframes.name: Lower
keyframes.cue: Bend your elbows and lower your chest.
